Our value added capabilities in metal fabrication, robotic production welding and CNC production machining, allows P&G to be an integrator of a variety of processes to provide a single source solution for our worldwide customers.

raw.name: Deltec
raw.description: Deltec provides custom component-parts manufacturing, fabrication, and engineering services from prototyping through production. Its in-house capabilities include laser cutting, CNC punching, bending, machining, welding, finishing, and powder coating. The company specializes in stainless and mild steel fabrications and precision TIG and MIG weldments for equipment manufacturers. It serves businesses in the greater Cincinnati area.
raw.seo_description: Deltec is a custom sheet metal fabrication and machine component job shop. Our business is comprised of six key disciplines; Laser Cutting | Machining | Bending | Welding | Finishing | Powder Coating. From prototype to production, our talented and dedicated team stands ready to assist you with your needs.
